questions.q: A bank statement feed loading transactions into Cash Management is typically which direction and pattern?
questions.explain: Bank feeds typically load data into Fusion (inbound) on a schedule (batch).

questions.q: What is a Financials consultant's typical actual role on an integration project?
options: Writing the entire integration's low-level code personally
Gathering requirements, validating sample payloads, defining field mappings, and documenting for the build team
questions.explain: The consultant's role centers on requirements, validation, and documentation, not hand-coding the integration.

questions.q: A consolidation tool extracting GL balances for group reporting is typically which direction?
questions.explain: Extracting data out of Fusion for reporting is outbound.

questions.q: Which course does this catalog's REST APIs and Integration Fundamentals course lead into next?
questions.explain: Per the Oracle Fusion Financials Consultant path's stage order, Oracle Fusion Security is next.

questions.q: Which chapter of this course covered authentication and establishing a properly scoped integration user?
questions.explain: Chapter 3, Authentication and Security, covered this.
